'''Garvin Delquist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Almas]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Delquist worked as a researcher at the [[Forard research station]], where he was part of a team studying the [[kaluthin]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] created by [[Darth Rivan]] to make Almas habitable. While he was there, he began to secretly fall in love with [[Misha Quor-Din]], a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] at the [[Almas Academy]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], something began killing the kaluthin and Delquist traveled to the [[Almas Sith fortress]] to search for any clues about why this was happening. However, he instead found a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]], which placed him under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

Based in the fortress, Delquist gathered a group of followers from among the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that operated on Almas. He had them capture Misha Quor-Din and bring her back to the fortress. However, she did not reciprocate the feelings he had for her, pushing him further under the influence of the dark side.
